title: OSD and applet: "Switch to external screen" action doesn't make sense or behave sensibly when there are 3 or more screens
line: With three or more screens, Meta+P and the Display Configuration applet now offer Use all screens, Only use external screens and Only use built-in screen, and they work.
explanation: OsdAction only handled exactly two connected screens: with three or more the OSD and applet still listed the six two-screen actions, and applying any of them did nothing. Draft MR kscreen!471 (Tobias Fella) fixes this; it is applied here with three changes. The actions now depend on the screen count: with 3+ screens extend left/right and mirror are hidden, a new Use all screens action is added, and Only use external screens / Only use built-in screen switch every external screen. On top of the MR, screens that get turned back on are placed to the right of the enabled ones instead of keeping stale positions (the MR stacked them on top of each other), the applet no longer reads a null config at startup and updates its actions when the screen count changes, and Use all screens uses the existing side-by-side icon because the MR's osd-use-all icon doesn't exist yet.

commits.message:
osd: Make useful for setups with more than two screens

With three or more screens the OSD and applet offered only two-screen
actions, which did nothing. Now they hide extend and mirror, add "Use
all screens", and turn screens on next to each other, not on top.

BUG: 421032

media.caption: Master, 3 screens: Meta+P shows the six two-screen actions
Fixed, 3 screens: Use all screens, Only use external screens, Only use built-in screen, Leave unchanged
Master, 3 screens: the Display Configuration applet shows the two-screen layouts
Fixed, 3 screens: the applet shows the three actions that work with 3 screens
Master: after choosing Only use external screen all three screens stay on
Fixed: after Only use external screens the built-in screen is off and the other two stay on side by side

review.text: Good direction building on kscreen!471 with solid improvements for the applet's null/NOTIFY handling, 3-screen action set, and a working stand-in icon. However, enableOutputs() does not ensure newly enabled outputs have a valid currentMode() before calling logicalSizeForOutputInt() (which returns 0 width and stacks outputs on top of each other when a disabled output has no mode), and Osd::showActionSelector() only sets the actions property on initial creation so a reused OSD within the 60-second cleanup timer displays stale actions after the monitor count changes.
changes: In common/osdaction.cpp enableOutputs(), ensure each newly enabled output has a valid currentMode() (extracting and reusing the best-mode fallback already in ExtendRight/ExtendLeft) before calling config->logicalSizeForOutputInt(*output), otherwise disabled outputs with no mode have width 0 and overlap at the same position; also avoid clamping right to 0 when all already-enabled outputs are at negative x coordinates.

In osd/osd.cpp Osd::showActionSelector(config) and osd/osdmanager.cpp, update the actions property on an already-created m_osdActionSelector->rootObject() and refresh the config used by the osdActionSelected handler so reusing the OSD within the 60-second cleanup timer after plugging/unplugging a monitor does not show stale 2- vs 3+-screen actions or apply against a stale Config.

In common/osdaction.cpp OsdAction::availableActions(), guard the count passed to i18ndp (e.g. std::max<qsizetype>(1, config->connectedOutputs().size() - 1)) against 0/-1 when fewer than 2 outputs are connected, and add unit tests in autotests/osdactiontest.cpp covering 3+-screen availableActions() and applyAction() (including re-enabling disabled outputs with no currentMode).

reviews.text: Functionally this closes the bug as titled. With 3+ screens the OSD and applet drop the meaningless extend and mirror actions and gain Use all screens, the external/built-in actions now handle every external output, and the shots and kscreen-doctor checks show it working, with 2-screen behaviour unchanged. The applet null-config guard and the NOTIFY change are correct, and placing re-enabled outputs to the right of the enabled ones fixes the MR's overlap. However, most of the code and the exact subject line come from Tobias Fella's commit 1d6cae59, and the patch is authored solely by Niccolò with no credit, which a maintainer (likely Tobias himself) won't accept. The commit message's 'not on top' describes the draft MR's behaviour, not master's.
changes: Credit Tobias Fella: keep his commit 1d6cae59 with him as author plus a separate follow-up commit for the placement and applet fixes, or at least add a 'Co-authored-by: Tobias Fella <tobias.fella@kde.org>' trailer.
Reword the commit message so it describes the change against master (drop 'not on top', which refers to the unmerged draft).

Optional hardening: in UseAll/SwitchToExternal, also reposition outputs that were mirroring another one before replication was cleared, since they would otherwise keep identical positions and overlap; make moreThanTwoMonitorsAllowedActions const.
